Microsoft Azure Get Scope Providers Microsoft Costmanagement Settings

params.name: scope
params.description: The scope associated with this setting. This includes 'subscriptions/{subscriptionId}' for subscription scope, 'providers/Microsoft.Billing/billingAccounts/{billingAccountId}' for Billing Account scope, 'providers/Microsoft.Billing/billingAccounts/{billingAccountId}/billingProfiles/{billingProfileId}' for billing profile scope.

items.docs: List all cost management settings in the requested scope.
